unverified_leads.title: Special Bundle Offer from Atomos and Oyen Digital
unverified_leads.author: Jennifer P
unverified_leads.summary: Atomos and Oyen Digital have announced a special bundle offer where purchasing an Atomos Ninja monitor-recorder with Oyen Digital Helix Mag40 storage includes a free magnetic mount. This promotion is valid until December 31, 2026.
unverified_leads.product: Atomos Ninja, Oyen Digital Helix Mag40
unverified_leads.source_excerpt: Upgrade your Atomos Ninja recording setup with Oyen Digital Helix Mag40 storage, certified by Atomos for use with its monitor-recorders. Now through December 31, 2026, buy an Atomos Ninja with an Oyen Helix Mag40 and receive a FREE Magnetic Mount.
unverified_leads.verification_note: GPT search lead with original publication date not independently proven.

unverified_leads.title: NDI | Atomos
unverified_leads.summary: Atomos has released AtomOS 11.11.00 firmware for Ninja and Shogun series devices, adding support for NDI6 HX3, enhancing video quality with HDR and 10-bit color depth.
unverified_leads.source_excerpt: With the introduction of AtomOS 11.11.00 for the Ninja and Shogun series, both modes are supported for NDI6 HX3.
unverified_leads.verification_note: GPT search lead with original publication date not independently proven.
